name: System Event Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies a type of event related to a system's operation.

LVCO.name: LVP Cut Off
LVCO.definition: Event is the cutoff time for low value payments processed by the system.

LVCC.name: LVP Cancellation Cut Off
LVCC.definition: Event is the cutoff time after which low value payments can no longer be cancelled.

LVRT.name: LVP Cut Off Report Time
LVRT.definition: Event is the time at which the members will be provided with the report corresponding to the processing of low value payments.

EUSU.name: Euro 1 Start Up
EUSU.definition: Event is the opening of the Euro 1 system operation.

STSU.name: Step 1 Start Up
STSU.definition: Event is the start of the Step 1 system operation.

LWSU.name: Limit Warning Start Up
LWSU.definition: Event is the start of the limit warning period.

EUCO.name: Euro 1 Cut Off
EUCO.definition: Event is the cutoff time for the Euro1 system, that is, the deadline for processing Euro1 transactions.

FIRE.name: Final Reporting
FIRE.definition: Event is the report after all operations have ceased in the system.

STDY.name: Start Of Day
STDY.definition: Event is the start of the operating day.

LTNC.name: LTN Cut Off
LTNC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the cash multilateral balances resulting from the overnight cycle of the securities settlement system.

CRCO.name: Cash Reservation Cut Off
CRCO.definition: Event is the cutoff for the cash reservation window.

RECC.name: Rec Cut Off
RECC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the multilateral balances stemming from the retail clearing system.

LTGC.name: LTG Cut Off
LTGC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the daytime cycle of the securities settlement system.

LTDC.name: LTD Cut Off
LTDC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the settlement of the cash multilateral balances resulting from the daylight cycle of the securities settlement system.

CUSC.name: Customer Cut Off
CUSC.definition: Event is the cutoff for customer payments.

IBKC.name: Interbank Cut Off
IBKC.definition: Event is the cutoff for interbank payments.

SYSC.name: System Cut Off
SYSC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the system.

SSSC.name: Net SSS Reservation Cut Off
SSSC.definition: Event is the cutoff for the securities settlement system cash reservation window.

REOP.name: Resume Operation
REOP.definition: Event is the expected resume time for a TARGET component.

PCOT.name: Processing Cut Off Time
PCOT.definition: Event is the cutoff time for the processing of payments.

NPCT.name: New Payment Cut Off Time
NPCT.definition: Event is the cutoff time for the receipt of new commercial payments.

ESTF.name: End Of Standing Facilities
ESTF.definition: Event is the cut off for the standing facilities.
